items.text: KomKast Global Technologies LLC
Connecting Businesses. Enabling Conversations. Driving Growth.
Effective Date: 8 November 2026 Last Updated: 8 November 2026
KomKast Global Technologies LLC ("KomKast", "we", "us" or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly.
KomKast is a technology company focused on business communication, AI-enabled customer engagement, CRM and business automation solutions for businesses worldwide.
This Privacy Policy explains how we may collect, use, disclose, retain and protect personal information when you:
Visit our website.
Submit an inquiry or contact form.
Request a product demonstration or consultation.
Communicate with our team.
Engage with us as a prospective or existing customer, partner or business contact.

This Policy applies to personal information collected through our public website and related business communications. Additional terms or privacy notices may apply when you use our products or enter into a separate agreement with KomKast.
Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect the following categories of information.
This may include:
Name.
Company or organization name.
Job title or professional role.
Business email address.
Telephone or WhatsApp number.
Country or general location.
Business requirements and areas of interest.
Information submitted through contact, inquiry, consultation or demonstration forms.
Information contained in messages, correspondence or other communications with us.
Please do not submit sensitive personal information through general website forms unless specifically requested through an appropriate and secure process.
When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, depending on the website configuration and technologies in use.
This may include:
IP address.
Browser type and version.
Device type and operating system.
Pages visited.
Date and time of visits.
Referring website or source.
General website usage and interaction information.
Technical information relating to website performance and security.

We may receive business contact or professional information from publicly available sources, business directories, referrals, business partners or other legitimate sources, where permitted by applicable law.
We use such information for relevant business development, communication and relationship-management purposes.
We may use personal information for legitimate business purposes, including:
Responding to inquiries and requests.
Communicating with prospective and existing customers.
Understanding business requirements.
Providing information about our products and solutions.
Arranging consultations, demonstrations and meetings.
Managing business relationships.
Following up on business opportunities.
Improving our website, products and customer experience.
Maintaining business and communication records.
Protecting our website, systems and business operations.
Preventing fraud, abuse and unauthorized activity.
Meeting applicable legal, regulatory and contractual obligations.
We aim to collect and use only information reasonably relevant to these purposes.

When you contact KomKast or express interest in our products or solutions, we may use the contact information you provide to respond to your inquiry and communicate with you about relevant business matters.
Where permitted by applicable law, we may also send relevant product updates, business information or promotional communications.
You may request that we stop sending promotional communications by using an available unsubscribe mechanism or contacting us directly.
Even if you opt out of promotional communications, we may continue sending necessary service-related, transactional or administrative communications where appropriate.
We do not intend to send unsolicited marketing communications in violation of applicable law.
We may disclose personal information where reasonably necessary for our business operations and the purposes described in this Policy.
This may include sharing information with:
Third-party providers that help us operate our website, manage communications, maintain systems, arrange meetings, process inquiries or support business operations.
Relevant partners may receive information where necessary to evaluate, support or deliver a requested business solution, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-protection requirements.
Legal, accounting, compliance or other professional advisers where necessary.
We may disclose information where required by law, legal process, regulatory obligations or to protect our legal rights and legitimate interests.
Information may be disclosed as part of a proposed or completed merger, acquisition, restructuring, financing or transfer of business assets, subject to applicable legal requirements.
We do not sell personal information as a business practice.
We do not authorize third parties to use personal information obtained through us for purposes unrelated to the services they provide or other permitted purposes.
Our website may use or link to third-party services and websites.
Depending on the services implemented, these may include website hosting, analytics, forms, communication tools, scheduling services, embedded media or other technologies.
Third-party providers may process information according to their own privacy policies and contractual arrangements.
KomKast is not responsible for the independent privacy practices of third-party websites that we do not control.
We encourage visitors to review the privacy notices of relevant third-party services.
We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy.
Retention periods may depend on:
The nature of the information.
The purpose for which it was collected.
The status of the business relationship.
Applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Legitimate business and record-keeping needs.
The need to resolve disputes or enforce agreements.
When information is no longer required, we take reasonable steps to delete, anonymize or otherwise securely dispose of it, subject to applicable retention obligations.
KomKast takes reasonable administrative, technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, disclosure or destruction.
However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
You should exercise appropriate care when transmitting information over the internet.
KomKast Global Technologies LLC is based in Houston, Texas, USA, and works with customers, partners and service providers internationally.
As a result, personal information may be transferred to, processed or stored in countries other than the country in which you are located.
Where applicable, we take reasonable steps to ensure that such processing and transfers are handled in accordance with relevant legal requirements.
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights relating to your personal information.
These may include the right to:
Request access to personal information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate information.
Request deletion of certain personal information.
Request information about how your personal information is processed.
Obtain a copy of certain personal information, where applicable.
Object to or opt out of certain processing activities.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Appeal certain decisions where applicable law provides that right.
For example, certain Texas residents may have rights under applicable Texas privacy legislation, subject to its scope, exemptions and requirements.
Privacy rights vary by jurisdiction and may not apply in every circumstance.
To submit a privacy request, contact us using the details in Section 15.
We may need to verify your identity or authority before responding. We will handle requests in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
Our website and business solutions are intended primarily for businesses and general audiences and are not directed toward children.
We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children through our website for purposes unrelated to our business activities.
If you believe a child has provided personal information to us inappropriately, please contact us so that we can review the matter.
Our website may contain links to external websites, platforms or resources.
These links are provided for convenience and informational purposes.
KomKast does not control the content, privacy practices or security of external websites. Visiting those websites is subject to their respective terms and privacy policies.

heading: Relationship with BotNFlow and Other Solutions

items.text: This Privacy Policy primarily addresses information collected through the KomKast public website and related business communications.
When a business uses BotNFlow or another KomKast solution, additional information may be processed as part of that business's use of the solution.

In such circumstances, the roles and responsibilities of KomKast and the customer, including how personal information is handled, may be governed by separate customer agreements, privacy terms or data-processing arrangements.

Where a customer uses BotNFlow to collect or manage information relating to its own customers, the customer may have separate responsibilities as the business determining the purposes and means of that processing.
This website Privacy Policy does not replace any applicable product-specific agreement or data-processing arrangement.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our business, website, technologies, data practices or applicable legal requirements.
The latest version will be published on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
We encourage visitors to review this Policy periodically.
For privacy-related questions, requests or concerns, please contact:
